name: X Weigh-in
description: Weigh in on your watch in seconds, in kg. A smoothed trend shows where your weight is heading beneath the day-to-day swings, with the change over the last week, a 30-day graph, your BMI and the calories you burn at rest. Your weigh-ins stay on the watch.

configFields.label: Birth year
configFields.description: Used for your age, which goes into the calories you burn at rest. 0 leaves it unset.

configFields.label: Birth month
configFields.description: 1 for January to 12 for December. 0 counts as January.

configFields.label: Sex
configFields.description: 1 for female, 2 for male. Used only to estimate the calories you burn at rest. 0 leaves it unset.
